paper.title: Vision-Based Anti-UAV Detection and Tracking
paper.venue: IEEE Transactions on Intelligent Transportation Systems, vol. 23, no. 12, pp. 25323-25334
paper.license: IEEE version: (c) 2022 IEEE, personal use only. arXiv version: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

claim: Existing deep detectors and trackers, retrained or run on a dedicated visible-light UAV dataset and fused with a simple score-gated rule, track UAVs much better than trackers alone.
problem: UAVs in video are tiny, blend into complex backgrounds and get occluded, so generic trackers lose them.

contributions.text: DUT Anti-UAV: a detection set of 10,000 images (5,200 train, 2,600 val, 2,200 test) and a tracking set of 20 hand-annotated videos (Sec. I, III).
14 detectors (Faster-RCNN, Cascade-RCNN, ATSS, YOLOX, SSD with ResNet18/50, VGG16, DarkNet backbones) retrained on the dataset, and 8 trackers evaluated (Sec. IV-A, IV-B; Tables II, III).

A fusion strategy of tracking and detection: the detector is consulted when the tracker's score falls below a threshold, and its best box replaces the tracker's when it is confident enough (Sec. IV-C, Fig. 7, Algorithm 1).

modules.name: Tracker initialisation
modules.input: first frame and its ground-truth box GT0

modules.name: Tracker
sizes: SiamFC: exemplar 127x127, search 255x255, response 17x17 (derived from SiamFC, not stated in this paper)
modules.defined_by: Sec. IV-B (trackers are existing methods); Algorithm 1

modules.name: Score gate
modules.output: keep bbox_t, or call the detector

modules.name: Detector
sizes: Faster-RCNN ResNet50: backbone strides 4/8/16/32, FPN levels P2-P6 (derived from the architecture, not stated in this paper)
modules.defined_by: Sec. IV-A (detectors are existing methods, retrained on the dataset)

modules.name: Fusion decision
modules.output: R_T, the box for frame t
modules.defined_by: Algorithm 1: if max(scores_d) > tau_d and > score_t then R_T = bbox_d else R_T = bbox_t

symbols.score_d: highest detector score on frame t

hyperparameters.name: tau_t, tau_d
hyperparameters.quote: In this paper, hyper-parameters τt and τd are set to 0.9.

hyperparameters.name: sensitivity
hyperparameters.quote: huge changes in parameters τt and τd only cause slight fluctuations in the tracking results (less than 1%).

released.code: No code for the fusion or the retrained detectors; the repository lists the dataset and references (github.com/wangdongdut/DUT-Anti-UAV, Apache-2.0).
released.data: Detection and tracking sets on Google Drive and Baidu, with annotations.
released.licenses: Repository Apache-2.0; the paper states the dataset is for academic research.

gaps.what: How score_t is computed for each tracker
gaps.why_it_matters: The gate compares it with 0.9; SiamFC's raw response is not a probability.
gaps.our_assumption: score_t = sigmoid of the peak of SiamFC's response map; stated on screen.

gaps.what: Whether the tracker continues from R_T after a detector box is chosen
gaps.why_it_matters: Decides where the tracker searches on the next frame.
gaps.our_assumption: The tracker's state is moved to R_T (its centre and size), so the next search is around the chosen box; stated on screen.

gaps.what: Detector input size and NMS settings used in retraining
gaps.why_it_matters: Affects the sizes shown on screen.
gaps.our_assumption: Not applicable to our run: we use torchvision's defaults for its COCO model and show those real sizes.
